outcome.technical: (1) plugins/audit/hooks/_config.py: new _git_entry_is_repository(at) - one os.stat of <at>/.git (followed through a link, as git follows one); a directory is a repository when it holds a HEAD entry (one lstat), a regular file when _read_pointer (the bounded reader _admin_of_tree already uses) returns a first line starting with 'gitdir:'; anything else is passed over. _checkout_of walks with it instead of lexists. _registered_trees now puts the found top first whenever the project lies below it (out = [top] if below), before and independent of reading a common directory; the main-tree reading by a common directory named .git stays for what it adds (deduplicated against the top); the member expansion moved to a small _with_member_places so the no-common-directory exit expands too. Docstrings of _checkout_of, _registered_trees and audit_config_way updated (the not-matched cf40d item now says 'from a project that is a linked worktree of it'). Not touched: _nested_tops, _tree_as_spelled, the session-tree walk, _holds_repository, tree_for, path_tree. (2) tests/test_guard_edits.py: new _topology_cases (cf41, cf41b, cf41c) over builders _topo_sepgit (git init --separate-git-dir, project R/a/b), _topo_submodule (git -c protocol.file.allow=always submodule add, project S/sub/app), _topo_stray_entry (empty R/mid/.git, project R/mid/app, worktree W), _topo_no_repository (X/.git an empty dir and Y/.git a file naming nothing, no repository above); topology_worlds() is shared with the journal suite; a world this git cannot build is a named skip via _harness.skip, any other build failure is a failing case. Member dimension: _GEN_MEMBER 'app' -> a/b; _member_world builds R/a/b and W/a/b, keeps P/app as the one-directory row; cf39b gains the twin 'between-project-and-checkout'; new cf39e and cf36d read the member depths off the worlds built. cf29's walk model updated to the new entry test. (3) tests/test_journal_writes.py: new _topology_question_cases (oq5e). (4) Docs: SECURITY.md, plugins/audit/README.md row, PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md (_config.py section and guard-edits section), CHANGELOG.md member-project entry.
